correctness.rationale: From the prescribed G(8,3) edges u_i u_{i+1}, u_i v_i, v_i v_{i+3}, independently reconstructed 16 vertices, 24 graph edges, 272 independent triples, 64883 faces including empty, complete 13-entry face vector, 32419 sequential element matches and exactly 45 critical 10-faces, no other unmatched faces. The matching includes the empty face; independent complete directed-Hasse acyclicity test traversed all 64883 faces and 515872 covers. The standard discrete-Morse reduced-complex convention yields one base point with 45 degree-10 cells; wedge type follows. Face dimension 12 excludes pure shellability. All claims are this one graph and k=3; no infinite-family inference from finite data.
residual_risks: Earlier unindexed G(8,3) or bounded-independence homotopy classification could still subsume the exact result.
The later general BI3 two-connectivity lemma now makes an alternate short derivation possible; chronological novelty, not perpetual uniqueness, is claimed.
No family theorem for generalized Petersen graphs is proved by the finite certificate.
